synopsis: Shintarou Mori, a first-year high school boy, is teased by his friends for wanting to find a beautiful girlfriend and having a sparkling social life. His classmate Inaho Sawatari is regarded as the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. The two of them shouldn't have anything to do with eacher, but when they're inadvertently mistaken for a couple, Inaho proposes: "How about we pretend we're really dating?" They act like a couple in public, but it turns out the most beautiful girl in the school is actually a very cute boy...! (Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

synopsis: High school boy Shinji Usui has a childhood friend named Hinata Ichinose — a guy who’s handsome and incredibly popular with girls, just like the hero of a rom-com. Being around Hinata, who’s as radiant and captivating as the sun, made Shinji feel pitiful by comparison, so at some point, he began to feel a bit uncomfortable around him. On the other hand, Hinata’s younger sister, Tsukina, treats him more kindly than she treats her own brother, for some reason. The story begins when Shinji — who has been trying to come to terms with these complex feelings — receives an ominously worded love letter. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
titleRomaji: Hanaori-san wa Tensei Shite mo Kenka ga Shitai
titleEnglish: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
titleNative: 花織さんは転生しても喧嘩がしたい
synonyms: Hanaori-san Wants to Have A Fight Even If She Reincarnates
synopsis: Narukami Ryusei is your typical NEET. He spends his days shut in his room playing video games without a care in the world, living a lazy life. But the truth is, Ryusei used to be a powerful demon king in another world! So why not spend this new life doing whatever he wants? Except, he wasn’t the only one reincarnated into this world. The hero who struck him down is here too—and she’s a really cute high school girl?! Can Ryusei survive reuniting with his foe in a new world, or will he find himself fighting even in this life? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
